description: The delivery vehicle for monofocus: one subject, three regions, and the layer discipline everything above content depends on.

MUST: Scroll its content region and only its content region.
Own the layer order, so chrome, overlays and system surfaces cannot be stacked ad hoc by call sites.
Apply safe-area padding to interactive controls while letting media bleed past them.
Resolve its page inset per layout scope rather than once per screen.
Keep one footer region carrying one subject.
SHOULD: End its scroll with enough padding that the last element is never pinned against chrome.
Host its overlays through one layer so toasts, sheets and menus share a single z-discipline.
NEVER: Gain a second subject of equal weight at a wider width. More pixels means more context, not more subjects.
Let a bleeding surface place controls outside the safe area.
